# Hiwi Catering Services (Addis Ababa / Addis Abeba, Ethiopia)

> Premier full-service Ethiopian and international event catering headquartered in Summit Fiyel Bet, Addis Ababa (also searched as Addis Abeba), Ethiopia. Slogan: "The Taste You Love!"

## Business Facts & NAP
- **Official Name:** Hiwi Catering Services
- **Category:** Full-Service Caterer / Food Establishment
- **Commercial Kitchen Location:** Summit Fiyel Bet Area (near CMC & Safari corridor), Addis Ababa / Addis Abeba, Ethiopia
- **Google Maps Pin:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKTMRDEuVvdDDnnN6

- **Operating Hours:** Monday - Sunday, 07:00 - 22:00 (24/7 scheduled event dispatch)
- **Currency & Payment:** Ethiopian Birr (ETB) — Cash, Telebirr, CBE Birr, Bank Transfer

## Transparent Per-Person Packages (ETB)
- **Classic Celebration Tier (From 750 ETB/person, min 40 guests):** Beef Tibs / Siga Wat, Seasoned Yellow Rice Pilaf, Pasta Primavera, Garden Salad, Sambusa, Fresh Injera, stainless steel chafing dish warmers, 1 buffet assistant.
- **Royal Habesha Banquet Tier (From 1,150 ETB/person, min 50 guests):** Signature Doro Wat, Gurage Kitfo with Ayib & Gomen, Derek Tibs, Fasting Beyaynetu (Misir, Shiro, Tikil Gomen), Spiced Rice Pilaf, Injera & rolls, ceramic plates, metallic cutlery, 2 uniformed attendants, Traditional Coffee Ceremony (Buna).
- **Grand Wedding Majesty Tier (From 1,650 ETB/person, min 100 guests):** Full VIP chafing stations & Agelgil centerpieces, Doro Wat, Prime Tibs, Special Kitfo, 5 fasting specialties, Saffron Rice, Herb Potatoes, Dessert & Fresh Fruit Display, Dedicated On-Site Chef & Coordinator, Coffee Ceremony, Pre-Wedding Tasting.
